explanation: The ability to think and act with knowledge, experience, understanding, and sound judgment.
The capacity to make good decisions and grasp complex situations or ideas.
The principle of acting rightly and fairly, in accordance with morality, ethics, and the law.
Correction or training used to improve a person's character or behavior.
A title often referring to God, the supreme power and creator of the universe.
People who possess wisdom, insight, and reason, and use this knowledge in a good way.
People who lack wisdom and reason, making poor decisions or acting unreasonably.
A close relationship between two or more people based on love, trust, support, and shared interests.
The way we communicate with each other through words, both spoken and written.
A symbol of speech and communication, and can also refer to the manner in which someone speaks or expresses themselves.
Often used metaphorically to represent a person's feelings, intentions, and inner being.
The state of existing, growing, and developing as a living being.
The end of life, when an organism ceases to exist and perform vital functions.
